closedFindings: Apply now restores visible focus after the preview collapses.
Rounded retention and sub-$0.01B shortfalls no longer contradict full-precision eligibility.
Captured Math.expm1 runtime differences receive a distinct qualified comparison; exact-only fields and changed decisions still fail.
Pending requests use a neutral label and failed retries remove earlier completion labels.
Shared desktop navigation wraps at 200% enlargement while phone navigation keeps its scroll rail.
The inherited Overview financing-heading overflow at 200% enlargement is closed by wrapping its worked-example button; normal and mobile row geometry is preserved.

numericComparison.relativeAllowance: 32 * Number.EPSILON on a restricted list of derived-output paths only
numericComparison.exactOnly: Inputs, terms, ownership, crossovers, metadata, categorical outcomes, rankings, ties, structure and all unlisted fields

preservedArtifacts.scope: All baseline public/lib, public/data, public/downloads, existing Node test files and API/build/package entry points

publishedScreenshot.source: Actual locator screenshot from the fresh independent browser pass; no compositing or generated imagery

limitations: Fresh counts do not include earlier partial or focused development passes.
This is scoped Chromium and AI-assisted engineering review, not a complete accessibility certification or an external financial audit.
The comparison allowance is not a formal propagated-error bound, financial-materiality threshold or proof of a future discrepancy cause.
The synthetic runtime fixture is regression evidence, not an independent numerical oracle.
Five-workspace navigation checks cover their headers; they are not full content audits of every workspace.
GitHub CI, deployed source identity, ordinary HTTPS and the live visitor journey are observed separately after publication.
Evidence hashes bind observations to bytes; they are not digital signatures.
